summary: Added and live-qualified metadata-only environment editing, routine edit/history screens, read-only redacted network inspection, binary/base64 CAS editing and conflict-safe drafts. Qualified env/state cookie loading and actual source-pinned 401 recovery using browser-derived test cookies. No claim that all requested gaps are closed. Canonical follow-up now qualifies cookie Code uploads, genuine allow/deny/exact session-rule reuse and native text/number/follow-up API continuation; extended panel parity remains incomplete. Final integration adds independently verified source-pinned auth recovery, capability enumeration and own-message blocking-prompt correlation. Fresh integrated auth/commands checks passed; API scope is explicitly separated from optional presentation, without closing the remaining web API gaps.
